column3: “Built on me” is rendered “besieged,” and “poison” as “bitterness.”
“Kidneys” is rendered “inward parts,” and “sons of his quiver” as “arrows of His quiver.”
The Hebrew reading tradition has “my soul … bows down”; an ancient scribal note says the original was “your soul.”
The Hebrew says “we have not met our end”; NASB has “never cease,” following some ancient versions.
“Good and waiting” is rendered “good that he waits.”
